title: Seniors' Mobility and Enabling Fund
summary: AIC scheme for eligible Singapore seniors needing mobility and assistive-device support, transport support, or home healthcare items.
claims: Use SMF as an official source to check mobility aid, assistive device, transport, and home healthcare item support.
Eligibility should be verified on AIC before presenting any final subsidy amount or application decision.

title: Home Caregiving Grant
summary: AIC monthly cash payout scheme for eligible families caring for persons with moderate to severe disabilities at home.
claims: HCG can be checked when a transcript indicates ongoing home caregiving expenses or disability-related care needs.
The user's eligibility and payout tier must be verified against AIC's current page.

title: Caregivers Training Grant
summary: AIC grant that subsidises approved caregiver training courses for eligible care recipients and caregivers.
claims: CTG is relevant when the transcript implies the caregiver needs training for mobility, daily living, dementia, or home-care tasks.
Only approved courses and current AIC rules should be treated as verified eligibility facts.

title: ElderFund
summary: AIC discretionary assistance scheme for lower-income Singapore Citizens with severe disability and long-term care needs.
claims: ElderFund should be considered only as an official lead when severe disability and long-term care cost concerns are present.
Means-test, disability assessment, and interaction with other long-term care schemes must be verified on AIC.

title: Interim Disability Assistance Programme for the Elderly
summary: AIC disability assistance scheme for older Singaporeans with severe disabilities who may need help with care costs.
claims: IDAPE can be surfaced as an official scheme lead for older care recipients with severe disability language in the transcript.
Eligibility and interaction with ElderFund, ElderShield, or CareShield Life must be checked on current AIC pages.

title: CareShield Life / ElderShield
summary: Long-term care insurance schemes that may provide payouts for eligible people with severe disability.
claims: CareShield Life and ElderShield are relevant when transcripts mention severe disability or inability to perform activities of daily living.
The agent must not claim eligibility without current scheme membership and disability assessment details.

title: Assistive Technology Fund
summary: SG Enable scheme for assistive technology support for eligible persons with disabilities.
claims: ATF is relevant for disability-related assistive technology or device needs.
Final eligibility and subsidy details must be verified with SG Enable.

title: 7 Fall Prevention Tips for Seniors and Caregivers
summary: HealthHub caregiver-facing fall prevention and home-safety information for seniors.
claims: Use this as a health-education source for fall prevention and home safety, not as a grant eligibility source.

title: MindSG: Managing Dementia As A Caregiver
summary: HealthHub MindSG caregiver information for supporting elderly parents with dementia.
claims: Use this as an official education source when dementia caregiving support is relevant.

title: Knowing Available Care Options
summary: AIC caregiver page covering available care options, care services, support groups, and financial grants.
claims: This is a useful official navigational source when the task is broad care planning rather than a single grant.
